label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

This is a request for new behaviour: only CSV and XLSX are currently supported (see SUPPORTED_FORMATS in src/exportUtils.ts, enforced through src/api/reports.ts). Adding a TSV option would mainly involve extending SUPPORTED_FORMATS/CONTENT_TYPES and the delimited-writer logic (toDelimited) in src/exportUtils.ts to support a tab delimiter, plus wiring it through the export API and UI.
